META_DESCRIPTION: Track phone, internet, and cable bills. FincWin's Telecom envelope reveals when your plans are costing more than they should.
HERO_H1:
Your phone bill keeps going up.
Does your plan?
HERO_SUB: Phone, internet, cable, streaming bundles — telecom is the category that creeps. A $5 price increase here, a new fee there. FincWin shows you the true monthly cost before your contract renews.
PAIN_ITEM_1_H3: The promotional rate that expired six months ago
PAIN_ITEM_1_P: Your internet provider quietly raised your rate from $59 to $79/month when your 12-month promo ended. You never noticed. That's $240 you didn't budget for.
PAIN_ITEM_2_H3: Three lines, four fees, zero clarity
PAIN_ITEM_2_P: Family mobile plan, hotspot add-on, device protection, and then the "administrative fee" that appeared in fine print. Your $80/month plan is actually $127.
PAIN_ITEM_3_H3: The contract renewal nobody reminded you about
PAIN_ITEM_3_P: You missed your cancellation window by two weeks. Now you're locked in for another 12 months at a rate 30% higher. It happens to everyone. FincWin helps you see it coming.
FEATURES_H2:
Your Telecom envelope
never lets a bill surprise you.
CARD_1_P: Set your Telecom budget and get a visual warning the moment your bills push past the threshold. Know before you overspend, not after.
CARD_2_P: Log every monthly plan as a recurring expense. FincWin auto-populates them each cycle, so your envelope starts the month already loaded with known costs.
CARD_3_P: Is your Telecom spend creeping? The month-over-month trend reveals when a carrier quietly raised your rate. See March vs. June at a glance.
